name: v2_wide_h_top_candidates
description: Second-round GRAPE bandwidth grid for v1 top candidate (image_type,S,R) combinations, extending signal bandwidth above the v1 upper bound.
notes: This grid is only for v1 top candidates, not the full S/R grid.
The main purpose is to check whether v1 selections at h=0.6/0.7 were constrained by the v1 upper bound.
Eligibility uses the same support rule as v1.
